summary: Completed Module 02 Step 1 CONTEXT: Analyzed the one-sentence spec 'Add team collaboration to the project management app', applied the Atomic Task Principle, and uncovered 6 discrete subtasks within the team invitations slice.
evidence: Identified 6 atomic subtasks: (1) invitation data model, (2) POST /teams/:id/invitations endpoint, (3) async email dispatch, (4) POST /invitations/:token/accept flow, (5) 7-day TTL expiry cleanup, and (6) admin revocation endpoint.
Isolated critical edge cases: idempotency on duplicate invites, handling already-registered members, and revoking pending invites if inviter permissions change.
Reinforced the 60/40 rule: spending 60% effort on upfront decomposition eliminates compounding iteration cycles caused by unstated assumptions.
